decisions.name: Root manifests and tests remain authoritative over navigation content
decisions.title: Root manifests and tests remain authoritative over navigation content
decisions.description: TreatCode registries are navigation and evidence data; implementation manifests, source, and tests decide current behavior.

decisions.name: Trit v2 image format is the current runtime boundary
decisions.title: Trit v2 image format is the current runtime boundary
decisions.description: The v2 runtime accepts the v2 image contract; v1 artifacts remain reproducible historical fixtures and are not runtime inputs.

decisions.name: Historical v1 boot artifact is not a v2 runtime input
decisions.title: Historical v1 boot artifact is not a v2 runtime input
decisions.description: The historical artifact is evidence for migration and compatibility only, not simultaneous production truth.

source_refs.reason: Retired from the v2 tree; the v1 seed is preserved at tag trit-v1-final.

decisions.name: Current v2 architecture supersedes the historical OS3 Phase 4 freeze
decisions.title: Current v2 architecture supersedes the historical OS3 Phase 4 freeze
decisions.description: The checked-in v2 manifests and implementation define current widths, ABI versions, and image readers; older OS3 freeze prose is historical context.

decisions.name: Historical OS3 Phase 4 v1 freeze is rejected as current truth
decisions.title: Historical OS3 Phase 4 v1 freeze is rejected as current truth
decisions.description: References to the old Phase 4 freeze are retained as history and do not silently override v2 source manifests.

source_refs.reason: The OS3 proposal tree is not present in the v2 repository.

decisions.name: Bootstrap allocation stays non-relational until storage is ready
decisions.title: Bootstrap allocation stays non-relational until storage is ready
decisions.description: The trap path and bootstrap allocator must not depend on the relational store before its buffer and WAL foundations exist.

decisions.name: Relational-first bootstrap proposal is not the current bootstrap order
decisions.title: Relational-first bootstrap proposal is not the current bootstrap order
decisions.description: The accepted architecture explicitly preserves a flat bootstrap phase and records the migration boundary.

source_refs.reason: Historical OS3 proposal is referenced by README but is not in the current tree.

decisions.name: Optional execution acceleration must retain interpreter equivalence
decisions.title: Optional execution acceleration must retain interpreter equivalence
decisions.description: Fast execution paths are optional and must preserve the reference interpreter and diagnostics while the direct native lowering gap remains open.

decisions.name: ASCII, UTF-8, and hexadecimal remain compatibility projections
decisions.title: ASCII, UTF-8, and hexadecimal remain compatibility projections
decisions.description: Host text, manifest, diagnostic, and binary-inspection behavior remains compatible while ternary-native notation is designed separately.

decisions.name: Ternary-native symbolic encodings are proposals, not guest ABI
decisions.title: Ternary-native symbolic encodings are proposals, not guest ABI
decisions.description: TASCII-81, exact trit literals, and compact dumps need a fixed table and conversion tests before they can become stable guest-facing contracts.

decisions.name: Encrypted-volume design remains an explicit two-track open decision
decisions.title: Encrypted-volume design remains an explicit two-track open decision
decisions.description: Compatibility integration and a possible ternary-native design are separate future capabilities; neither is implemented or selected by this registry.

decisions.name: Self-hosting follows stable storage, product, and distribution boundaries
decisions.title: Self-hosting follows stable storage, product, and distribution boundaries
decisions.description: The native compiler is a late consumer of the persistent OS and release stack, not a replacement authority before those boundaries are verified.
